parts.title: The Skateboard and the Twelve Year Olds — Part 1

series.summary: Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio run through the endless underground tunnel in the First Phase of the Hunter Exam. A silver-haired boy named Killua joins Gon on a skateboard, sparking an instant friendship and rivalry between the two twelve-year-olds.

segments.voiceover_text: Two hours into the first phase, examiner Satotz leads hundreds of applicants through a pitch-black tunnel with no finish line in sight.
A silver-haired boy named Killua glides alongside on a skateboard. Leorio explodes in fury, shouting that using wheels in an endurance test is blatant cheating.
Gon defends him, pointing out that the examiner only said to follow him. Killua grins, amused by the boy's quick thinking.
Killua asks Gon's age and discovers they are both twelve years old. He kickflips his skateboard into his hand and matches Gon stride for stride, leaving Leorio fuming.

series.summary: As the underground marathon exceeds eighty kilometers, the oppressive humidity and grueling pace begin breaking the applicants. Tonpa fakes exhaustion to lure others into quitting, while Leorio strips off his suit and pushes his body to the brink of collapse.

segments.voiceover_text: The underground marathon passes forty kilometers, and the damp air begins breaking minds and bodies as exhausted runners collapse along the tunnel floor.
Past sixty kilometers, veteran applicant Tonpa fakes total collapse. He sprawls onto the stone ground, hoping to lure desperate rookies into quitting alongside him.
Leorio is drenched in sweat and gasping for breath. He rips off his jacket and necktie, clutching his pounding chest as his stamina completely evaporates.
At eighty kilometers, Kurapika drops back to keep pace with his failing friend. He questions why Leorio would torture himself for mere wealth, sparking a bitter confrontation.

parts.title: Scarlet Eyes and the Stolen Dream — Part 3

series.summary: Kurapika confides his mission to avenge the slaughtered Kurta clan and recover their stolen scarlet eyes from the Phantom Troupe. Leorio reveals his own heartbreak over a friend lost to curable illness, before collapsing unconscious onto the stone floor.

segments.voiceover_text: Kurapika reveals his tragic past: the Kurta Clan's scarlet eyes. Five years ago, the Phantom Troupe slaughtered his entire family to sell their eyes, and he lives only for revenge.
Leorio fires back with his own heartbreaking secret: his best friend died of a curable illness simply because they were poor. He needs money to become a doctor and save lives.
Kurapika is humbled by Leorio's noble ambition and quietly apologizes, realizing his friend is anything but greedy.
Having bared his soul, Leorio's body gives out. He collapses face-down on the cold floor, completely unconscious as the runners leave him behind.

parts.title: The Desperate Sprint and the Briefcase — Part 4

series.summary: Refusing to give up, Leorio surges back to his feet with an explosive roar and sprints forward in pure desperation. Gon snags Leorio's forgotten briefcase with his fishing rod, catching up to Killua as they discuss Gon's mysterious Hunter father.

segments.voiceover_text: Gon pauses beside his fallen friend, refusing to leave him behind. Suddenly, Leorio roars with fury, leaps up, and sprints forward in a manic burst of pure willpower.
Leorio leaves his briefcase behind in his sprint. Gon whips out his fishing rod, snags the handle with a perfect cast, and reels it in while running.
Gon catches up to Killua at the front. Fascinated by Gon's loyalty, Killua asks why he wants to become a Hunter so badly.
Gon explains his father left him to be a Hunter, so the job must be incredible. Killua smiles, intrigued by his weird logic.

parts.title: The Endless Stairs and the Race — Part 5

series.summary: The applicants encounter a massive, punishing staircase leading out of the tunnel. Gon and Killua wager a dinner bet and race up hundreds of stairs at breakneck speed, bursting across the finish line into the sunlight simultaneously.

segments.voiceover_text: The flat tunnel ends, revealing a monstrous staircase climbing into the dark. Satotz accelerates, and exhausted applicants collapse in agony on the punishing stone steps.
Gon and Killua surge to the front of the pack. Killua dares Gon to a race to the summit, betting that the loser must buy dinner.
The two twelve-year-olds sprint up the brutal stairs side by side at breakneck speed, leaving the gasping crowd far behind as daylight appears overhead.
They burst into the sunlight at the exact same instant. They laugh and bicker over who won, while the massive stone door slams shut behind them.

parts.title: The Impostor Examiner and Hisokas Test — Part 6

series.summary: Emerging into the misty Numere Wetlands, the applicants are confronted by a mysterious man claiming examiner Satotz is a deceptive monster. Hisoka tests them with lethal playing cards, killing the impostor and allowing the true trial to proceed.

segments.voiceover_text: The survivors emerge into the foggy Numere Wetlands. Satotz warns that deceptive monsters inhabit the swamp, mimicking humans to lead victims to their doom.
Suddenly, a battered man drags out a dead ape with Satotz's exact face. The stranger claims Satotz is an impostor, throwing the crowd into total paranoia.
Without warning, Hisoka flings razor-sharp playing cards at both figures. Satotz catches the blades effortlessly between his fingers, while the accuser drops dead instantly.
Hisoka smiles, declaring that a real Hunter examiner would never fail to defend himself. Satotz warns against future attacks, leading the survivors deeper into the perilous mist.
